user.title: Set up Adaptive Heating
user.description: Select entities from your existing device integrations. Initial mode is Observe and sends no commands. Temperature limits and targets below are in °C; selected sensors may use °C or °F. Power inputs may use W or kW. Battery and grid charge/discharge inputs must be separate positive power measurements. Map the current controller's enabled switch as the inhibit input during migration. Optional disinfection raises the normal tank target and verifies a continuous measured hold. Historical defaults are 68°C target, 65°C for 5 minutes, every 12–16 days; check them for your installation. Disinfection has its own Observe/Automatic mode and starts in Observe. Restoring an interrupted tank target can still run in Observe or Off. Cold-night planning is optional and initially disabled. It uses a forecast through the morning and an adaptive, conservative cooldown estimate; it does not calculate COP or promise electricity savings. The proposed 20°C minimum and 23°C ceiling must suit your house. AC assistance has its own Observe mode, needs both main and AC Automatic to command, and borrows only an AC that is Off. Verify its outdoor operating limit. A configured AC power meter enables a session energy budget; without one only the runtime limit applies. An interrupted owned AC may be restored to Off even in Observe/Off.

data.solar_preheat: Allow limited preheating from sustained solar surplus
data.battery_ready_soc: Battery percentage required for optional preheating
data.preheat_degrees: Maximum extra room target for preheating (°C)
data.tank_target_entity: Normal hot-water tank target number (optional, separate from heating)
data.disinfection_hold_minutes: Continuous time at or above threshold (minutes)
data.disinfection_sample_seconds: Maximum tank sample age and gap (seconds)
data.cold_night_enabled: Enable forecast-driven cold-night preparation and coasting
data.night_minimum: Minimum room temperature during overnight coasting (°C)
data.floor_lead_hours: Floor heating response / recovery lead time (hours)
data.morning_hour: Expected useful morning sunshine / recovery hour (local, 0–23)
data.cold_drop: Forecast temperature drop that warrants preparation (°C)
data.protection_entity: Other room temperature that can prevent overnight coasting (optional)
data.ac_entity: AC climate entity for optional preparation assistance
data.ac_room_entity: External temperature sensor in the AC room
data.ac_power_entity: AC electrical power meter (optional; enables measured session budget)
data.ac_min_outdoor: Lowest outdoor temperature permitted for AC assistance (°C; verify equipment)
data.ac_preheat_max: Maximum room temperature for AC assistance (°C)
data.ac_min_on_minutes: Minimum AC run (minutes; stops sooner for temperature/operating limits)
data.ac_min_off_minutes: Minimum AC rest before another session (minutes)
data.ac_settle_minutes: Exclude AC effects from learning after stopping (minutes)
data.ac_max_session_kwh: AC session electricity budget when a meter is mapped (kWh)
data.ac_sample_seconds: Maximum AC sensor age and meter sampling gap (seconds)

error.invalid_limits: Check the temperature, rate, and time limits. Extra preheating must fit within the comfort tolerance.
error.entity_missing: Select an existing entity of the required type.
error.already_controlled: Another Adaptive Heating entry already controls this setpoint.
error.state_required: Enter the exact state that means space heating (for example HEAT or on).
error.temperature_required: The output number must have a °C or °F temperature unit.
error.battery_incomplete: Select all three battery measurements, or leave all three empty.
error.solar_incomplete: Solar preheating needs measured PV, grid import, and grid export power.
error.invalid_disinfection_limits: Check disinfection temperatures, hold duration, sample age, scheduling window and timeout.
error.tank_incomplete: Select both the measured tank temperature and its normal tank target, or leave both empty.
error.separate_tank_target: Use the normal hot-water tank target, not the space-heating target.
error.invalid_tank_target: The tank number must be available, use °C or °F, and support the configured target within its minimum, maximum and step.
error.disinfection_active: Cancel disinfection and wait for normal tank target restoration before changing settings.
error.invalid_planning_limits: Check the night minimum, room target, preheat ceiling, floor delay and local hours. Morning must precede preparation, which must precede overnight coasting.
error.invalid_ac_limits: Check the AC outdoor limit, ceiling, minimum/maximum run, rest time, sensor age and session electricity budget.
error.ac_active: Select AC assistance Off and wait for confirmed restoration before changing settings.
error.ac_incomplete: Select both an AC climate entity and an external room thermometer, or leave all AC mappings empty.
error.ac_heat_required: The AC must support explicit Heat and Off modes.
